name: warrior
description: a Warrior, a barbarian clubman: shaggy brown hair under an orange headband, bare muscular tan arms, a brown fur-trimmed leather tunic with a cream fur strap across the chest, a brown belt with a round silver buckle, a ragged cream-fur loincloth skirt, fur-wrapped brown leather boots, a big wooden club studded with cream bone spikes in his RIGHT hand and a round wooden shield with a cream fur rim on his LEFT arm
hands: the club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the club is lifted beside the head with its spiked head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the spiked club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the club is level, its spiked head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the spiked club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its spiked head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the club dipping, shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's spiked head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, club and shield on the ground beside him
